name: 37948-multiimage-qwen3vl8b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct -- public, ungated, image-text-to-text, ~17 GB of bf16 safetensors.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- one in-process vLLM engine on one GPU.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 1000 requests with a 900 s safety cap.
workload: four-picture chat: four distinct 256x256 JPEGs plus a ~94-token question per request, 32 tokens generated. The pictures come from four separate one-image `synthetic_image` generators (seeds 42-45), so every picture is distinct both within a request and across requests.
purpose: A visual question-answering assistant comparing four photos per question, serving 32 concurrent users with short answers on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line. ENGINE: commit 4f6eed3bd4a92c6bd513460ee85b917d6df88a17
# (v0.18.2rc0-28-g4f6eed3bd4a9). The interpreter and the hardware are in configs/env.yaml.
model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096

# Deliberately above scenario.json's 32 streams, so the operating point is the stream count.
max-num-seqs: 64

# Must equal the picture count in scenario.json; change one and you must change both.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 4}

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# Off deliberately: every picture in every request is distinct, so neither cache can hit on the
# part of the prompt that costs anything.
enable-prefix-caching: false
mm-processor-cache-gb: 0
